items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: We have a 75-year-old bassist named Bob Abrams

ctx.x: And I’m old. Somebody said, “How old is your band.” I said well our band is over 50 years old, and I’m the elderstatesman you might say. I have the second — we’re long in the tooth — I have the second longest set of teeth in the band. He says, “Well who has the longest ones?” “Well” I said, “We have a 75-year-old bassist named Bob Abrams, and he has the longest set of teeth, and with a marvelous set of incisors like that I suppose © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
he’s out somewhere auditioning for the lead role in a Dracula production. You know what a sweet man he is.
